Nettippakaraṇa
Bud. Abhidharma. earliest treatise of Buddha's teachings; rewritten an. rearranged version of Peṭakopadeśa with omissions an. additions; ascribed to (Mahā) Kaccāyana; prob. composed in 1st Cent. A. D. See Warder, Indian Buddhism p.. 299. 316. 319.
Alwis p.. 70-78. Colombo p. 51 (2 mss.). Colombo D. I. 1230. 1801. Fausböll 131. IO. Pāli p. 61 (no. 20b). Paris Pāli p. 35.
Pt.. (1) with Extr.. from Dhammapāla's C. PTS. 50. London, 1902. (2) in Sinhalese script. with C. of Dhammapāla. Colombo, 1921. (3) Eng. transl. by Ñāṇamoḷi. The Guide. PTS. 1962.
--C. Atthasam3vaṇṇanā by Dhammapāla I. Colombo p. 51 (a..). Colombo D. I. 1231. Fausböll 132.
Ed. by Piyatissa. Hewavitarane Ser. Colombo, 1921.

Netratribhāgabrahmayaśasvin
poet. Śp. 3464. Smv. p. 151 (a..). verse q. by Ānandavardhana. (vrIDAyogAt…netratribhAgaH).
Sobriquet of Brahmayaśasvin. See JOR. Madras XVIII. p. 257. Prob. same a. Brahmayaśasvāmin, mentioned by Abhinavagupta a. a. of Puṣpadūṣitaka. [Page218-a.
